backend/main.mo: Motoko backend handling authorization, user profiles, contact inquiries with admin restrictions, and editable site content defaults.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence mapping features to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend source file.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind/OKLCH dark‑mode‑first theme variables and base styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point enabling dark mode and loading the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component handling hash routing, rendering home sections, admin view, and cookie banner.
frontend/src/components/admin/SiteConten: Admin form for editing site content fields with React Query update logic.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Screen shown on unauthorized admin access with login prompt and home navigation.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Provides a login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading handling and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: Renders an about section with heading, description, feature cards, and themed background.
frontend/src/components/sections/Contact: Implements a contact form with validation, inquiry submission, and dynamic contact info display.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: Displays a hero banner with video or fallback image, headings, stats, and scroll-to-contact actions.
frontend/src/components/sections/Ratings: Allows users to submit ratings and comments while showing average and recent ratings.
frontend/src/components/sections/Service: Shows a services list with icons, descriptions, images, and buttons that scroll to the contact section.
frontend/src/components/site/CookieConse: Shows a cookie consent banner using local storage to remember acceptance or decline.
frontend/src/components/site/Footer.tsx: React footer component with logo lightbox, social links, quick navigation, and scroll-to-section behavior.
frontend/src/components/site/Header.tsx: Responsive header with navigation, mobile sheet menu, and a logo lightbox trigger.
frontend/src/components/site/LogoLightbo: Modal component that displays an enlarged logo with escape key handling and click-to-close behavior.
frontend/src/config/contact.ts: Exports static contact email and phone configuration values.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useContactInquiry.ts: Empty hook file with no implementation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInquiries.ts: Empty hook file with no implementation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity context, login handling, identity persistence, and helper state flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for inquiries and ratings plus helpers to parse structured message fields.
frontend/src/hooks/useSiteContent.ts: React Query hooks to fetch and update site content with defaults and success/error toasts.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, theme CSS variables, dark mode values, base styles, and utility animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity provider and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Implements the admin dashboard with identity checks, data fetching, filtering, and UI layout.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helper functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme extensions, color tokens, plugins, and component styling rules.
project_state.json: Stores project configuration, requirements, issues, and architectural notes for the Legend Techno Solutions site.
